gecko._comment: Two floors matter here. 128 is where optional_host_permissions arrives in Firefox MV3, and below it there is no way to grant site access at all, so the picker could never appear. 140 is where data_collection_permissions is understood, and Mozilla requires that key on new submissions; on 128-139 it is accepted but silently ignored, which AMO flags. 140 is therefore the binding number and 128 is only the reason the extension cannot go lower still.

gecko_android._comment: Android trails desktop on data_collection_permissions by two releases, and gecko_android does not inherit gecko's minimum, so the floor is declared again rather than left to default.
